name: Kyle Bartz
message: Tango, I had the honor of knowing you for several months and you made an indelible mark on my heart. You really are a beautiful soul. I hope to meet you again someday over the Rainbow Bridge. Rest easy and Godspeed.

name: Ken Onken
message: Our hearts are filled with sadness but we know you are no longer in pain. Our sympathies are with your family as well as the Menomonee Falls Police Department and our community.
